sn55.29:1.1: nisinnā kho te bhikkhū Bhagavā etad avoca || || 3--6. ||pe || la || || Yato kho bhikkhave ariyasāvakassa imāni pañcabhayāni verāni vūpasantāni honti || imehi catuhi sotāpattiyaṅgehi samannāgato hoti || ayaṃ cassa ariyo ñāyo paññāya sudiṭṭho hoti supaṭividdho || || So ākaṅkamāno attanā va attānaṃ vyākareyya Khīṇanirayo mhi khīṇatiracchānayoniyo khīṇapittivisayo khīṇāpāyaduggativinipāto sotāpanno ham asmi avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano ti || ||
